sentences.text: This animal possessed long and strong hind legs alongside atrophied forelimbs that formed a single claw.
It is believed that Patagonykus may have been covered in feathers.
Gregory S. Paul estimated in 2010 that Patagonykus was 1 meter long and weighed 3.5 kilograms.
However, other estimates suggest it could have reached two meters in length and weighed 47 kilograms.
The genus was discovered in the Portezuelo Formation of the Neuquén Basin in Neuquén Province.
Patagonykus is classified within the family Alvarezsauridae, which includes taxa such as Mononykus and Alvarezsaurus.
Specifically, Patagonykus is placed as the sister genus to Bonapartenykus within the taxon Patagonykinae.
The parent group of Patagonykus is Alvarezsauroidea.
The type species of the genus Patagonykus is Patagonykus puertai.
Patagonykus puertai is the only known species of the extinct genus Patagonykus, an alvarezsauroid theropod that lived about 92 million years ago during the Turonian in what is now South America.
Patagonykus lived from the Turonian to the Coniacian, between 93.9 and 85.7 million years ago.
